stemMarkdown: The average of 20 numbers is 26. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 21 numbers divided by 21. If the new number added is 129, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 20 numbers $= 20 \times 26 = 520$. New sum $= 520 + 129 = 649$. New average $= \dfrac{649}{21} = 30.90$.
